projects.name: API-Driven Rent Collection & Mandate Platform
details: •Worked on API-driven integration project for Sohar International bank connecting Core Banking Systems, CBO, and
partner platforms for rent collection
•Gathered and analyzed requirements for APIs including account enquiry, authentication, UI design, mandate
execution, debit/ credit posting, and status callbacks.
•Performed interface analysis and data mapping, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across systems.
•Acted as a liaison between business, product, and development teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high- availability integrations.
•Improved turnaround time for mandate execution and status updates by 30–40% through streamlined API flows.
•Configured Postman requests for seamless integration and testing of web services, ensuring optimal performance and
reliability.
•Supported development processes, monitored deployments, and ensured smooth functionality post-implementation.
•Managed integrations over APIs and web services, enabling efficient communication and data exchange between
systems.

projects.name: Regulatory, Audit & Information Security Compliance
details: •Supported information security, regulatory, and audit initiatives in the organisation.
•Actively involved in VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS audits, including coordination with auditors and internal
teams.
•Assisted in control documentation, evidence collection, audit observation tracking, and remediation closure.
•Ensured compliance with security, audit, NPCI, UIDAI, and regulatory requirements across applications and processes.
•Worked with stakeholders to mitigate risks and support audit sign-off and regulatory readiness.
•Supported 100% audit closure on time across VAPT, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS with zero critical observations
